page.layout: One page of running text, with a left margin note beside the paragraph "Id uidere est" and "Auctor huius rei". Running head top right, page number top left. A catchword at the foot on the right.

p.i: Proiecerunt itaque sors, & cecidit sors ipsa super Ionam.

main_text.p: Si ita uobis uidetur, fratres carissimi, omissa ὑποθέσει[?], in qua nihil obscurum est, ad thesin progrediemur, ac de Sontium inquisitione miranda, dicemus. Iunio-res in transcurfu obseruent hæc prouer-bia, quæ ad nostrum institutum faciunt: Reperit Deus nocentem: ἀνὴρ θεὸς τὸν ἀ-[?]λιτήριον[?]. Item: Vel mus mordeat improbum. Item: Ibyci grues.

1. Sontium per sortes inquisitio, prouidentiæ (cui omnia manifesta sunt, etiam occulta hominum) mirado modo seruit. Id uidere est in hac narratione de Iona Propheta, qui sorte deprehensus est ab ijs, qui cum eo in eadem naui erant.
2. Auctor huius rei Deus est, qui, cum interest ipsius gloriæ, fontes, ceu Cacos, in lucem protrahit.[illegible, ~6 letters]-[illegible, ~4 letters]

Ita ingenium est hominum animaliū, ut φιλαυτίας[?] fascinati, non nisi à Deo cordium cognitore, rei peragi & conuinci possint. Homines enim facilè fallunt, simulando integritatem, & dissimulando peccata.

page.notes: Left margin Greek note (beside paragraph 2) is very faint and could not be read letter by letter; marked as illegible. Greek words in the body (ὑποθέσει, ἀνὴρ θεὸς τὸν ἀλιτήριον, φιλαυτίας) are uncertain and carry [?]. A mark after "uidere" looks like a comma or cedilla, not a letter; it is omitted. "mirado" and "facilè" are copied as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
